# Acculynx

AccuLynx is the leading, all-in-one roofing software designed to streamline every aspect of a roofing business.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/acculynx/.

## Actions

- **Add job appointment**: This endpoint allows users to schedule the initial appointment for a specific job in the acculynx system.
- **Create a contact**: Creates a new contact in the acculynx system with detailed information for use in roofing and construction project management.
- **Create a job**: Creates a new job in the acculynx system with the provided details.
- **Create a lead**: This endpoint creates a new lead in the acculynx system, specifically for residential roofing projects.
- **Job appointment summary** (read-only): Retrieves a list of appointments from the calendar associated with a specific job in acculynx.
- **List of calendars for the location** (read-only): Retrieves a list of calendars associated with the authenticated user or organization in acculynx.
- **List of contact types related to the company** (read-only): Retrieves a list of all available contact types in the acculynx system.
- **Update company representative**: This endpoint allows you to add a company representative to a specific job within the acculynx system.
